tools.name: lookup_employee
tools.description: Look up an employee record by id or name.

tools.name: get_pay_stub
tools.description: Fetch an employee's pay stub for a pay period.

tools.name: list_pay_runs
tools.description: List recent pay runs and their status.

tools.name: get_timesheet
tools.description: Read an employee's timesheet for a week.

tools.name: update_bank_details
tools.description: Change the bank account an employee is paid into.

tools.name: issue_bonus_payment
tools.description: Create a one-off bonus payment for an employee.

tools.name: add_pay_adjustment
tools.description: Add a correction line (earning or deduction) to an employee's next pay run.

tools.name: approve_timesheet
tools.description: Approve a submitted timesheet for payment.

tools.name: create_off_cycle_payment
tools.description: Schedule an immediate payment outside the regular pay run.

tools.name: update_tax_withholding
tools.description: Change an employee's tax withholding settings.

tools.name: post_internal_note
tools.description: Add a note to an employee's payroll file.
